title: Close out Phase 4: retro + plan the next epic
description:
Retro, fold learnings into .tick/learnings.md inside the 150-line cap (compact, do not append — Phases 2 and 3 both had to drop entries to pay for new ones), verify the epic outside-in against its definition of done with a REAL unattended loop, then plan the next feasible epic.

The verification bar for an autonomy epic is higher than for the ones before it: a loop that works when you are watching is not the thing being built. Prove one ran, did the right thing, and reported it, with nobody in the loop.
closed_reason: Completed: Phase 4 retro on the epic; three learnings folded into .tick/learnings.md at the 150-line cap; the epic verified outside-in by a REAL unattended loop — PR #59 reviewed by run_6e3550f9 from a read-only credential, with nobody in the loop — and the two clauses that are built but not live-verified recorded as not-claimed; the project's A1-A6 assessed on w1z; six branches of uncollected paid work flagged on 72y; ko8 closed to match its children.
